units.literal: Thereupon together they inscribed stone to hymn him, styling him Master Profound Virtue.

units.zh: 年八十九，中平五年，以寿终。
units.en: He died at eighty-nine in Zhongping 5.
units.literal: At age eighty-nine, in the fifth year of the Zhongping era, he ended his years by natural lifespan.

units.zh: 汉阴老父
units.en: The old man of Hanyin
units.literal: The old man of Hanyin

units.zh: 汉阴老父者，不知何许人也。
units.en: No one knows the old man of Hanyin's home.
units.literal: The old man of Hanyin—no one knows from what place he was.

units.zh: 桓帝延熹中，幸竟陵，过云梦，临沔水，百姓莫不观者，有老父独耕不辍。
units.en: Emperor Huan, touring Jingling and Yunmeng, halted on the Han—every soul crowded the bank save one greybeard who kept plowing.
units.literal: In the Yanxi era of Emperor Huan he visited Jingling, passed through Yunmeng, and came to the Han River; among the common people there was none who did not watch, except one old man who alone kept plowing and did not stop.

units.zh: 尚书郎南阳张温异之，使问曰：“人皆来观，老父独不辍，何也？”
units.en: Secretary Zhang Wen of Nanyang sent to ask why he alone would not look up?
units.literal: Secretary Zhang Wen of Nanyang thought him strange and sent someone to ask, "All men have come to watch; the old man alone does not stop—why?"

units.zh: 老父笑而不对。
units.en: The elder laughed and said nothing.
units.literal: The old man laughed and did not answer.

units.zh: 温下道百步，自与言。
units.en: Zhang left his carriage and walked a hundred paces to speak alone.
units.literal: Wen stepped down from the road a hundred paces and himself spoke with him.

units.zh: 老父曰：“我野人耳，不达斯语。
units.en: The greybeard said, "I am a bumpkin—I do not grasp fine speech.
units.literal: The old man said, "I am a rustic; I do not understand such language.

units.zh: 请问天下乱而立天子邪？
units.en: Tell me—was the Son of Heaven raised because the world was in chaos?
units.literal: May I ask: the realm was in chaos and therefore they set up a Son of Heaven?

units.zh: 理而立天子邪？
units.en: Or because it was well ordered?
units.literal: Or because it was well ordered they set up a Son of Heaven?

units.zh: 立天子以父天下邪？
units.en: Was he made father to the realm?
units.literal: Did they set up a Son of Heaven to be father to the realm?

units.zh: 役天下以奉天子邪？
units.en: Was the realm yoked merely to pleasure the throne?
units.literal: Or to toil the realm in order to serve the Son of Heaven?

units.zh: 昔圣王宰世，茅茨采椽，而万人以宁。
units.en: Ancient sages ruled from thatch and bark—yet the people rested easy.
units.literal: In antiquity the sage kings ruled the age with thatched roofs and plain rafters, yet the myriad people thereby had peace.

units.zh: 今子之君，劳人自纵，逸游无忌。
units.en: Now your master exhausts the folk to indulge his tours without limit.
units.literal: Now your lord toils others while indulging himself, roams and plays without restraint.

units.zh: 吾为子羞之，子何忍欲人观之乎！”
units.en: I blush for you—how dare you ask them to gawk!"
units.literal: I am ashamed for you—how can you bear to want people to watch!"

units.zh: 温大惭。
units.en: Zhang burned with shame.
units.literal: Wen was greatly ashamed.

units.zh: 问其姓名，不告而去。
units.en: He asked the elder's name; the man walked off in silence.
units.literal: He asked his name; the old man did not tell him and departed.

units.zh: 陈留老父
units.en: The old man of Chenliu
units.literal: The old man of Chenliu

units.zh: 陈留老父者，不知何许人也。
units.en: The Chenliu elder's origins are lost.
units.literal: The old man of Chenliu—no one knows from what place he was.

units.zh: 桓帝世，党锢事起，守外黄令陈留张升去官归乡里，道逢友人，共班草而言。
units.en: When the partisan proscriptions began, Waihuang magistrate Zhang Sheng resigned and met a friend on the road; they sat on bundled grass to talk.
units.literal: In the age of Emperor Huan, when the affair of the partisan prohibitions arose, Zhang Sheng, who was guarding the magistracy of Waihuang in Chenliu, left office and returned to his home village; on the road he met a friend, and together they spread mat grass and spoke.

units.zh: 升曰：“吾闻赵杀鸣犊，仲尼临河而反；
units.en: Zhang said, "When Zhao slew Mingdu, Confucius turned back from the river;
units.literal: Sheng said, "I have heard that when Zhao killed Mingdu, Confucius came to the river and turned back;

units.zh: 覆巢竭渊，龙凤逝而不至。
units.en: overturn the nest and drain the pool—dragons and phoenixes will not stay.
units.literal: when the nest is overturned and the pool is drained, dragon and phoenix depart and do not come.

units.zh: 今宦竖日乱，陷害忠良，贤人君子其去朝乎？
units.en: Now eunuchs daily wreck the state and trap the good—must worthies flee the hall?
units.literal: Now the eunuchs daily throw things into disorder, trap and injure the loyal and good—will gentlemen quit the court?

units.zh: 夫德之不建，人之无援，将性命之不免，奈何？”
units.en: If virtue fails and we lack allies, how shall we save our necks?"
units.literal: When virtue is not established and men have no support, will we not fail to preserve our lives—what can be done?"

units.zh: 因相抱而泣。
units.en: They clung together weeping.
units.literal: Thereupon they embraced each other and wept.

units.zh: 老父趋而过之，植其杖，太息言曰：“吁！
units.en: An old man strode by, planted his staff, and sighed, "Ah!
units.literal: An old man hurried past them, planted his staff, and with a great sigh said, "Alas!

units.zh: 二大夫何泣之悲也？
units.en: Why do two ministers weep so hard?
units.literal: You two great men—why do you weep so bitterly?

units.zh: 夫龙不隐鳞，凤不藏羽，网罗高县，去将安所？
units.en: Dragons do not hide scales, phoenixes do not hide plumes—with nets set high, where will you flee?
units.literal: The dragon does not hide its scales; the phoenix does not conceal its feathers; the net is hung high—where will you go when you leave?

units.zh: 虽泣何及乎！”
units.en: Tears come too late!"
units.literal: Though you weep, what does it reach!"

units.zh: 二人欲与之语，不顾而去，莫知所终。
units.en: They called after him; he never turned, and none traced his path.
units.literal: The two men wished to speak with him; he paid no heed and departed, and no one knew his end.

units.zh: 庞公者，南郡襄阳人也。
units.en: Lord Pang lived in Xiangyang in Nan commandery.
units.literal: Lord Pang was a man of Xiangyang in Nan commandery.

units.zh: 居岘山之南，未尝入城府。
units.en: He farmed south of Mount Xian and never crossed the city wall.
units.literal: He dwelt south of Mount Xian and never entered the walls of the commandery seat.

units.zh: 夫妻相敬如宾。
units.en: He and his wife honored each other like guests.
units.literal: Husband and wife treated each other with the respect due guests.

units.zh: 荆州刺史列表数延请，不能屈，乃就候之。
units.en: Inspector Liu Biao summoned him in vain, then rode to his field.
units.literal: The provincial inspector Liu Biao several times extended invitations and could not bend him, and therefore went in person to wait on him.

units.zh: 谓曰：“夫保全一身，孰若保全天下乎？”
units.en: Liu said, "Saving yourself—how does it weigh against saving the realm?"
units.literal: He said to him, "To preserve one body—how does that compare with preserving all under heaven?"

units.zh: 庞公笑曰：“鸿鹄巢于高林之上，暮而得所栖；
units.en: Pang laughed, "The goose nests in the tall wood and finds rest by dusk;
units.literal: Lord Pang laughed and said, "The swan builds its nest in the high forest and at evening obtains where it roosts;

units.zh: 鼋鼍穴于深渊之下，夕而得所宿。
units.en: the great turtle burrows in the deep and sleeps by night.
units.literal: the great turtles burrow in the depths of the abyss and at evening obtain where they lodge.

units.zh: 夫趣舍行止，亦人之巢穴也。
units.en: A man's choices of stay or go are only nests and burrows.
units.literal: As for the inclinations of going, staying, walking, and halting—these too are man's nests and burrows.

units.zh: 且各得其栖宿而已，天下非所保也。”
units.en: Each finds his own roost—the realm is not ours to save."
units.literal: Moreover, each obtains his roost and lodging only; all under heaven is not what one preserves."

units.zh: 因释耕于垄上，而妻子耘于前。
units.en: He dropped his plough on the ridge while his wife hoed in front of him.
units.literal: Thereupon he set aside plowing on the ridge while his wife and children weeded before him.

units.zh: 表指而问曰：“先生苦居畎亩而不肯官禄，后世何以遗子孙乎？”
units.en: Liu pointed at the field: "You toil in mud and spurn salary—what legacy for your sons?"
units.literal: Biao pointed and asked, "Sir, you bitterly dwell in the furrows and will not accept office and salary—how will later generations leave something to your sons and grandsons?"

units.zh: 庞公曰：“世人皆遗之以危，今独遗之以安。
units.en: Pang answered, "The world leaves children danger; I leave them peace.
units.literal: Lord Pang said, "The people of the world all bequeath them peril; now I alone bequeath them safety.

units.zh: 虽所遗不同，未为无所遗也。”
units.en: The gifts differ—yet both are inheritances."
units.literal: Though what is bequeathed differs, it is not that nothing is bequeathed."

units.zh: 表叹息而去。
units.en: Liu sighed and rode away.
units.literal: Biao sighed and departed.

units.zh: 后遂携其妻子登鹿门山，因采药不反。
units.en: Later he led wife and children up Mount Lumen gathering herbs and never came down.
units.literal: Later he therefore took his wife and children and climbed Mount Lumen, and because he gathered herbs did not return.

units.zh: 赞曰：江海冥灭，山林长往。
units.en: Verdict: Rivers and seas swallow men; mountains and forests are the long road away.
units.literal: The encomium states: Rivers and seas darken and vanish; mountains and forests are the long road of going.

units.zh: 远性风疏，逸情云上。
units.en: Their natures ran wide as wind; their hearts rode higher than cloud.
units.literal: Far-reaching nature, wind-thin; withdrawn feeling, cloud-high.

units.zh: 道就虚全，事违尘枉。
units.en: The Way fills the void whole; the world they left was dust and bend.
units.literal: The Way attains emptiness and wholeness; affairs turn from dust and crookedness.

units.zh: 尚書敬顯儁曰：「孔子云：『微管仲，吾其被發左衽矣』以此言之，右衽為是。」
units.en: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."
units.literal: Minister Jing Xianjun said, "Confucius said, 'Were it not for Guan Zhong, we would wear our hair loose and our lapel to the left.' By this reasoning the right lapel is correct."

units.zh: 五月，封舅曼子侍中騎都尉光祿大夫王莽為新都侯。
units.en: In the fifth month, maternal uncle Man's son Wang Mang, Attendant at the Palace and Cavalry Commandant Guanglu Grandee, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xindu.
units.literal: Fifth month, enfeoffed maternal uncle Man son Attendant at the Palace Cavalry Commandant Guanglu Grandee Wang Mang as Xindu Marquis.

units.zh: 赤松子
units.en: Master Chisong
units.literal: Chisongzi

units.zh: 年二十，遭王莽敗，世祖即位於冀州。
units.en: At twenty he lived through Wang Mang's fall and watched Liu Xiu raise the Han banner in Ji.
units.literal: At twenty he encountered Wang Mang's collapse, and the Founding Ancestor took the throne in Ji Province.

units.zh: 伏願陛下哀忠念舊，愛孤恤寡，矜愚嘉善，舍過記功，敦骨肉之情，廣寬仁之路，思堯、舜之風，慕禹、湯之德，克己復禮，以成美化，天下幸甚。」
units.en: I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."
units.literal: I venture to hope Your Majesty will pity the loyal and remember the old, cherish the orphaned and comfort the widowed, pity the foolish and praise the good, pardon faults and record merit, thicken kinship among flesh and bone, broaden the path of generous forbearance, think of the manner of Yao and Shun, admire the virtue of Yu and Tang, restrain yourself and return to ritual, to complete a transformation of culture — all under Heaven would be greatly blessed."

units.zh: 好讀《太玄經》，註揚雄《蜀都賦》。
units.en: He loved to read the Classic of Supreme Mystery and annotated Yang Xiong's Rhapsody on the Capital of Shu.
units.literal: He loved to read the Classic of Supreme Mystery and annotated Yang Xiong's Rhapsody on the Capital of Shu.

units.zh: 每云：「我欲與揚子雲周旋。」
units.en: He would often say, "I wish to keep company with Yang Ziyun."
units.literal: He would often say, "I wish to keep company with Yang Ziyun."

units.zh: 老子曰：「其政察察，其人缺缺。」
units.en: Laozi said, "When government is excessively exacting, the people grow impoverished in spirit."
units.literal: Laozi said: "When government is minutely scrutinizing, the people are deficient and incomplete."

units.zh: 又曰：「法令滋章，盜賊多有。」
units.en: He also said, "When laws and statutes proliferate, thieves and bandits multiply."
units.literal: He also said: "When laws and decrees multiply, robbers and bandits abound."

units.zh: 父崎，順帝時為司徒。
units.en: His father Liu Qi served as Minister of Education under Emperor Shun.
units.literal: His father Qi, in Emperor Shun's time, was Minister of Education.

units.zh: 時穆子容為巡省使，嘆曰：「古人有言：『聞伯夷之風，貪夫廉，懦夫有立。』
units.en: At the time Mu Zirong was touring inspector; he sighed and said, "The ancients said: 'Hear the wind of Bo Yi, and the greedy grow honest; the timid stand firm.'
units.literal: At the time Mu Zirong was touring inspector; he sighed and said: "The ancients had a saying: 'When one hears the wind of Bo Yi, the greedy grow honest and the timid stand firm.'

units.zh: 李渾 子湛 渾弟繪 族子公緒 李璵 弟瑾 族弟曉 鄭述祖 子元德
units.en: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande
units.literal: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande

units.zh: 與梁人泛言氏族，袁狎曰：「未若我本出自黃帝，姓在十四之限。」
units.en: With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said, "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen."
units.literal: With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said: "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen."

units.zh: 建始以來，王氏始執國命，哀、平短祚，莽遂篡位，蓋其威福所由來者漸矣！
units.en: Since Jianshi, the Wang clan began to grasp the state's fate. Ai and Ping had short reigns, Mang then usurped the throne—indeed the source of his power and fortune was gradual!
units.literal: Jianshi since, Wang clan began grasped state fate, Ai, Ping short blessings, Mang then usurped position, cover his power blessing what from came gradually indeed!

units.zh: 時，大司徒侯霸欲與交友，及丹被征，遣子昱候於道。
units.en: Grand Minister Hou Ba wanted his friendship; when Wang Dan was summoned to court, Hou sent his son Hou Yu to greet him on the road.
units.literal: At that time Grand Minister of Education Hou Ba wished to befriend him, and when Dan was summoned, he sent his son Yu to wait on the road.

units.zh: 丹曰：『君房有是言，丹未之許也。』
units.en: Wang Dan replied, 'If your father said that, I have never agreed to it.'
units.literal: Dan said, 'If Junfang had such words, Dan has not assented to them.'

units.zh: 昱曰：『家公欲與君結交，何為見拜？』
units.en: Hou Yu said, 'My father means to befriend you—why do you bow back as if to an equal?'
units.literal: Yu said, 'My father wishes to befriend you; why do you return the bow?'

units.zh: 若乃莊周偃蹇於漆園，老萊婆娑于林窟，嚴平澄漠於塵肆，梅真隱淪乎市卒，梁生吟嘯而矯跡，焦先混沌而槁杌，阮公昏酣而賣傲，翟叟遁形以倏忽。
units.en: As for Zhuang Zhou lounging in Qiyuan, Lao Lai wandering in forest caves, Yan Ping settling into clarity in the dusty market, Mei Zhen hiding among market servants, Master Liang chanting and whistling while lifting his traces, Jiao Xian in muddled stump-like stillness, Ruan Gong drunk and selling pride, and old Zhai vanishing in an instant:
units.literal: As for Zhuang Zhou lounging in Qiyuan, Lao Lai wandering in forest caves, Yan Ping settling into clarity in the dusty market, Mei Zhen hiding among market servants, Master Liang chanting and whistling while correcting his traces, Jiao Xian in muddled stump-like stillness, Ruan Gong drunk and selling pride, and old Zhai vanishing in an instant:

units.zh: 對曰：「數尋伊、霍之傳，不讀曹、馬之書。」
units.en: He replied, "I pore over the lives of Yi Yin and Huo Guang — not the chronicles of Cao Cao and the Sima clan."
units.literal: He replied: "I often seek the biographies of Yi Yin and Huo Guang; I do not read the books of Cao [Cao] and the Sima [clan]."

units.zh: 元坦 元斌 元孝友 元暉業 元弼 元韶
units.en: Yuan Tan; Yuan Bin; Yuan Xiaoyou; Yuan Huiye; Yuan Bi; Yuan Shao
units.literal: Yuan Tan; Yuan Bin; Yuan Xiaoyou; Yuan Huiye; Yuan Bi; Yuan Shao

units.zh: 至七年五月，詔三公曰：「漢當郊尧。
units.en: In the fifth month of the seventh year, he issued an edict to the Three Excellencies, saying, “Han ought to sacrifice to Yao at the suburbs.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year, he issued an edict to the Three Excellencies, saying, “Han ought to sacrifice to Yao at the suburbs.

units.zh: 時侍御史杜林上疏，以爲「漢起不因缘尧，与殷、周異宜，而舊制以高帝配。
units.en: At that time Attendant Censor Du Lin presented a memorial, holding that “Han’s rise did not follow a line from Yao; its proper observances differ from those of Yin and Zhou, whereas the old arrangement matches Emperor Gao.
units.literal: At that time Attendant Censor Du Lin presented a memorial, holding that “Han’s rise did not follow a line from Yao; its proper observances differ from those of Yin and Zhou, whereas the old arrangement matches Emperor Gao.

units.zh: 昔在帝尧，聪明密微，让与舜庶，后裔握机。
units.en: Formerly under Emperor Yao, intelligence was subtle and profound; he yielded to Shun the common people, and his descendants grasped the pivot.
units.literal: Formerly under Emperor Yao, intelligence was subtle and profound; he yielded to Shun the common people, and his descendants grasped the pivot.

units.zh: 樞肆志尋覽，殆將周遍，乃喟然歎曰：「吾聞貴爵位者以巢、由為桎梏，愛山林者以伊、呂為管庫，束名實則芻芥柱下之言，翫清虛則糠秕席上之說，稽之篤論，亦各從其好也。
units.en: Shu read through them almost entirely and sighed: "I hear that men who prize office take Chao Fu and Xu You as shackles, and men who love the hills take Yi and Lü as storekeepers; those who bind name to fact treat Laozi as straw, and those who play at emptiness treat banquet talk as chaff. In earnest judgment each follows his own bent.
units.literal: Shu with full intent searched and read them, nearly covering all; he then sighed and said: "I have heard that those who prize rank and title take Chao Fu and Xu You as fetters, and those who love mountains and forests take Yi and Lü as granary keepers; binding name and reality makes Laozi's words mere hay; playing with emptiness and purity makes seat-side doctrines mere chaff; checked against earnest discourse, each also follows his own preference.

units.zh: 孝章皇帝深惟古人之道，助三正之微，定律著令，冀承天心，順物性命，以致時雍。
units.en: Emperor Zhang pondered antiquity, harmonized the three beginnings in law, and hoped to align Heaven with the nature of things for universal peace.
units.literal: Emperor Zhang deeply pondered the Way of ancients, assisting the subtlety of the three beginnings; fixing statutes and establishing orders; hoping to inherit Heaven's heart, comply with creatures' natures and lives, so as to bring seasonal harmony.

units.zh: 肅宗集諸儒於白虎觀，恭特以經明得召，與其議。
units.en: When Emperor Zhang convened scholars at White Tiger Hall, Gong was invited on strength of his classical expertise and joined the debates.
units.literal: Emperor Suzong assembled the Confucians at White Tiger Hall; Gong was specially summoned because of his clarity on the classics and participated in their discussions.

units.zh: 初，肅宗時，斷獄皆以冬至之前，自後論者互多駁異。
units.en: Under Emperor Zhang capital cases had to conclude before the winter solstice; later scholars quarreled endlessly over the rule.
units.literal: Formerly, in Emperor Suzong's time, cutting prison cases was all before the winter solstice; afterward debaters mutually increased refutations and differences.

units.zh: 建初元年，肅宗詔舉賢良方正，大司農劉寬舉丕。
units.en: In Jianchu 1 Emperor Zhang sought worthy candidates; Minister of Agriculture Liu Kuan nominated Lu Pi.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianchu, Emperor Suzong ordered recommendation of worthy and upright men; Minister of Agriculture Liu Kuan recommended Pi.

units.zh: 其後帝巡狩之趙，特被引見，難問經傳，厚加賞賜。
units.en: Later, when the emperor toured Zhao, Pi was specially summoned, examined on the classics, and richly rewarded.
units.literal: Afterward, when the emperor toured Zhao, Pi was specially summoned for audience, questioned on the classics, and richly rewarded.

units.zh: 鄭均字仲虞，東平任城人也。
units.en: Zheng Jun, styled Zhongyu, was from Rencheng in Dongping.
units.literal: Zheng Jun, courtesy name Zhongyu, was a man of Rencheng in Dongping commandery.

units.zh: 兄為縣吏，頗受禮遺，均數諫止，不聽。
units.en: His elder brother served as a county clerk and took bribes; Zheng Jun warned him again and again, without effect.
units.literal: His elder brother was a county clerk and rather received gifts and presents; Jun several times remonstrated to stop him, but he did not listen.

units.zh: 均好義篤實，養寡嫂孤兒，恩禮敦至。
units.en: Zheng Jun loved duty and meant what he said; he supported his widowed sister-in-law and her orphans with unstinting kindness.
units.literal: Jun was fond of righteousness, earnest and solid; he raised his widowed sister-in-law and orphan children, favor and ritual were thick and thorough.

units.zh: 均於是客於濮陽。
units.en: Zheng Jun then withdrew to live as a guest in Puyang.
units.literal: Jun thereupon sojourned as guest at Puyang.

units.zh: 元和元年，詔告廬江太守、東平相曰：『議郎鄭均，束脩安貧，恭儉節整，前在機密，以病致仕，守善貞固，黃發不怠。
units.en: In Yuanhe 1 an edict told the governors of Lujiang and Dongping: 'Gentleman Consultant Zheng Jun lives frugally on a teacher's stipend, humble and orderly; he left confidential office for illness, keeps faith in old age, and never slackens.'
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanhe, an edict instructed the grand administrator of Lujiang and the minister of Dongping, saying, 'Gentleman Consultant Zheng Jun, with bundle of dried meat is content in poverty, respectful, frugal, restrained, and orderly; earlier in secretarial posts he retired on illness, guards goodness and is chaste and firm, yellow-haired without slackening.'

units.zh: 明年，帝東巡過任城，乃幸均舍，敕賜尚書祿以終其身，故時人號為『白衣尚書』。
units.en: The next year, passing Rencheng on an eastern tour, the emperor called at Zheng Jun's home and granted him a director's salary for life—so men dubbed him the 'minister in plain clothes.'
units.literal: The next year, the emperor on eastern tour passed Rencheng, thereupon visited Jun's house, ordered bestowal of a Director of the Secretariat's salary for the rest of his life; therefore people of the time called him the "commoner Director of the Secretariat."

units.zh: 後以病乞骸骨，拜議郎，告歸，因稱病篤，帝賜以衣冠。
units.en: Later he asked to retire, was made gentleman consultant, went home pleading mortal illness, and received cap and gown from the throne.
units.literal: Later citing illness he begged for his bones, was appointed Gentleman Consultant, announced return home, thereupon claimed grave illness; the emperor bestowed on him cap and robes.

units.zh: 再遷尚書，數納忠言，肅宗敬重之。
units.en: Promoted twice to director of the secretariat, he spoke plainly and often; Emperor Zhang held him in high regard.
units.literal: Twice transferred to Director of the Secretariat, he repeatedly submitted loyal words; Emperor Suzong respected him.

units.zh: 少好黃、老書。
units.en: In youth he studied the Yellow Emperor and Laozi.
units.literal: In youth he was fond of the books of the Yellow Emperor and Laozi.

units.zh: 即脫身為傭，歲餘，得錢帛，歸以與兄。
units.en: He hired himself out as a laborer; after a year he brought home coin and silk for his brother.
units.literal: Thereupon he left his person to become a hired laborer; after more than a year he obtained cash and silk, returned and gave them to his elder brother.

units.zh: 常稱病家廷，不應州郡辟召。
units.en: He habitually pleaded illness at home and ignored every provincial summons.
units.literal: He constantly claimed illness at home in the courtyard, and did not answer province and commandery summons.

units.zh: 建初三年，司徒鮑昱辟之，後舉直言，並不詣。
units.en: In Jianchu 3 Minister Bao Yu called for him, and later he was nominated for blunt counsel; he answered neither summons.
units.literal: In the third year of Jianchu, Minister of Education Bao Yu summoned him; later he was recommended for outspoken integrity; both times he did not go.

units.zh: 六年，公車特征。
units.en: In the sixth year the court sent the imperial coach for him alone.
units.literal: In the sixth year, the public carriage specially summoned him.

units.zh: 永元中，卒於家。
units.en: He died at home during the Yongyuan era.
units.literal: In the Yongyuan period, he died at home.

units.zh: 曰：『物盡可復得，為吏坐臧，終身捐棄。』
units.en: He said, 'Goods can always be replaced, but a clerk convicted of graft is ruined forever.'
units.literal: He said, 'Things when exhausted can be obtained again; to be a clerk and sit for corruption goods is to be cast off for life.'

units.zh: 郡將欲必致之，使縣令譎將詣門，既至，卒不能屈。
units.en: The regional commander was determined to have him and tricked the county magistrate into delivering him to the yamen gate, yet could not force him to serve.
units.literal: The commandery general wished necessarily to get him and ordered the county magistrate deceitfully to escort him to the gate; when he had arrived, in the end could not bend him.

units.zh: 其賜均、義谷各千斛，常以八月長吏存問，賜羊酒，顯茲異行。』
units.en: Grant each a thousand hu of grain; each eighth month let local officials call on them with sheep and wine to mark their rare virtue.'
units.literal: Let each be granted a thousand hu of grain; constantly in the eighth month let the senior clerk inquire after them and bestow sheep and wine, displaying these unusual conducts.'

units.zh: 三年一祭，于仲春之月祭伏犧于陳州，神農於亳州，軒轅於坊州，少昊於兗州，顓頊於開州，高辛於歸德府，陶唐於平陽府，虞舜、夏禹、成湯於河中府，周文王、武王於京兆府。
units.en: Sacrifices were held once every three years: in mid-spring Fuxi was honored at Chen Prefecture, Shennong at Bozhou, the Yellow Emperor at Fang Prefecture, Shaohao at Yan Prefecture, Zhuanxu at Kai Prefecture, Gaoxin at Guide Prefecture, Emperor Yao at Pingyang Prefecture, Shun, Yu, and Tang at Hezhong Prefecture, and Kings Wen and Wu of Zhou at Jingzhao Prefecture.
units.literal: Sacrificed once every three years: in the middle spring month Fuxi was sacrificed to at Chen Prefecture, Shennong at Bozhou, Xuanyuan at Fang Prefecture, Shaohao at Yan Prefecture, Zhuanxu at Kai Prefecture, Gaoxin at Guide Prefecture, Taotang Yao at Pingyang Prefecture, Yu Shun, Xia Yu, and Cheng Tang at Hezhong Prefecture, and King Wen and King Wu of Zhou at Jingzhao Prefecture.
